notes:
Summary: Masthead TagWorks builds auto-tagging and summarization layers for mid-size e-com and telco support stacks. Primary objective is reduce TTR and deflection by surfacing concise summaries + 3 deterministic tags that map to Zendesk macros and Freshdesk workflows. POC scope: import 6 months historical tickets (~1.2M messages), run nightly batch summarization + real-time tagging for new tickets in Zendesk via private app. Key requirements:
- Throughput/latency: tag prediction <300ms median on live flow; batch summarization acceptable as nightly job for historical backlog. Needs to prove 2x end-of-month spike resilience (expected peak ~350 RPS)
- Integrations: Zendesk private app + Freshdesk webhooks, macros population, internal routing tool-calls (POST to /routing/v1)
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-managed hosted API for rapid POC, dedicated if throughput/cost warrants. Interested in quantized model recommendations (4-bit) and advice from Optimize on batching and cache profiles.
- Security/compliance: must have SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs for tagging decisions, KMS for key storage, data residency in us-east-1. Retention controls: ability to purge PII and logs after 90 days on request.
Shorthand notes / rep call snippets:
- "Legal wants subprocessor list before pilot."
- "POC needs runbook for rollback if tag regression >5%"
- "Customer will test macros mapping and accept 1:1 tag->macro mapping initially"
Open items: request SOC2 report, provide architecture diagram (network flows, VPC options), benchmark under 500 concurrent inference requests.
